sloka: स नास्ति परमित्येव कुरु बुद्धिं महामते ।प्रत्यक्षं यत्तदातिष्ठ परोक्षं पृष्ठत: कुरु ॥ २.१०८.१७॥
transliteration: sa nāsti paramityeva kuru buddhiṁ mahāmate ।pratyakṣaṁ yattadātiṣṭha parokṣaṁ pṛṣṭhata: kuru ॥ 2.108.17॥

translations.english: O highminded one thinking that the next world does not exist, practise whichever is evident and perceivable. And turn your back on what is beyond perception.
